name: Tomato o Kai ni Iku Game
original_name: トマトを買いに行くゲーム
source: A young girl is caring for you as you lie in bed. You ask her to bring you a tomato. And then another. And another. Until...
translation: A young girl is caring for you as you lie in bed. You ask her to bring you a tomato. And then another. And another. Until...
